description: This file contains functions related to platform upgrade procedures on a Linux-based embedded device, including image validation, bootloader upgrade, partition handling, and configuration copying.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the image by checking its magic word and comparing partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the appropriate partition.

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the device's bootloader using grub-bios-setup.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full USB or disk upgrade process, including partition replacement and UUID updates.
